name: Motor-Driven Cycle
description: A motorcycle, including a motor scooter, whose motor produces 5 horsepower (3,750 W) or less: the light end of the motorcycle category, regulated as a motorcycle. Defined by Montana Code Annotated §61-1-101(44), which excludes bicycles and mopeds.

restrictions.rule: A motorcycle: a seat or saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground
Its motor produces 5 horsepower (3,750 W) or less
Pedals with no more than 2 brake horsepower and a 30 mph top speed make it a moped instead
Riders need a driver's license with a motorcycle endorsement
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a helmet
Registered as a motorcycle, and the owner must carry liability insurance
One designed for off-road recreation is an off-highway vehicle unless it's modified to meet the highway equipment standards and registered for the road
